injections.defect: The ingest of b-0596 wrote its 71 rows and died before the checkpoint; the batch was re-fetched from the same cursor as b-0597.
injections.expected_handling: The aborted batch counts for nothing (no checkpoint, counted false); the replay accepts each key exactly once; the checkpoint versions stay consecutive.
injections.name: crash after the data write, before the checkpoint

injections.defect: Two backfill requests (bf-006 and bf-012) overlap an earlier accepted request of the same source.
injections.expected_handling: Each is refused with BACKFILL_OVERLAP and keeps its id; the earlier request stands; touching half-open ranges are accepted.
injections.name: overlapping backfills

injections.defect: A client retries src-shipments 80 s too early after a 429 with retry-after 120 s.
injections.expected_handling: The early retry is refused with RETRY_TOO_SOON (429, Retry-After header, nothing staged); the fetches recorded in fetch_log all wait at least retry-after.
injections.name: retries that ignore retry-after

injections.defect: From 2026-09-15 src-payments declares schema_version 2 and adds the required field channel; the first page (b-0847) arrives before the expected version is bumped.
injections.expected_handling: The batch is quarantined whole with SCHEMA_CHANGED and the checkpoint does not move; an operator bumps the expected version explicitly and the window is fetched again.
injections.name: an unexpected required field

injections.defect: b-0405 carries a row with no record_id and no key.
injections.expected_handling: The row is quarantined MISSING_FIELD with a null source_key and has a quarantine row; received equals accepted + duplicate + quarantined + deleted for the batch.
injections.name: a malformed row that would vanish

injections.defect: src-refunds stops delivering new events at 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z but its fetches keep succeeding.
injections.expected_handling: Freshness (now minus the latest accepted event) reads three days while the ingestion age stays hours; completeness of the silent partitions is 0; every run is green.
injections.name: a green job on a stale source

injections.defect: run-1187 fails its critical relationships check; a pipeline that publishes it anyway would replace the current publication with a snapshot that failed the gate.
injections.expected_handling: The gate blocks, the run fails, an incident opens, no publication row exists and the pointer stays on the previous publication.
injections.name: a failed run that would replace a publication

injections.defect: ORD-012484 is accepted in b-1019 and cancelled by a delete event in b-1022 the same day; a pipeline that ignores op = delete would keep it in every later snapshot.
injections.expected_handling: The delete row is classified deleted; the record leaves the snapshot from the first publication that includes the delete and appears as a deletes exclusion in the reconciliation; a delete of an unknown key is quarantined DELETE_TARGET_UNKNOWN.
injections.name: a delete that is not propagated

injections.defect: 9 src-orders events dated 2026-09-17 18:00..23:50 arrive in b-0932 (2026-09-18), after the preceding publication whose watermark is later than they are.
injections.expected_handling: Each is accepted, counted as a late event with the publication it is behind, and included in the next publication; none is lost.
injections.name: a late event behind the watermark

injections.defect: src-web-events answers the fetch from off-000693 with next_cursor off-000693, the cursor just fetched.
injections.expected_handling: The fetch stops with CURSOR_LOOP (409) and is recorded; the session is dead; a new session fetches the window; no batch is created by the looping page.
injections.name: a pagination token that repeats

injections.defect: A structured log line (and a fault note) carries an API key, a bearer token and a token in a URL.
injections.expected_handling: Every secret span is replaced by [REDACTED] before the line is emitted or stored; a line that still matches is withheld whole.
injections.name: a secret in a structured log line

injections.defect: A workflow that runs on push to main commits and pushes to main without a skip marker.
